cases.description: When a newly created Zone has no SOA record added, getSOA() should return null.

cases.expected: SOARecord instance (same object that was added)
cases.description: After adding an SOARecord to the Zone (via addRecord or appropriate method), getSOA() must return that exact SOARecord object.

cases.expected: identical SOARecord instance on successive calls
cases.description: Verify that multiple invocations of getSOA() on a Zone that already contains an SOARecord always return the same reference (no new objects are created).
Create a new Zone, add a generic Record (e.g., an ARecord) using addRecord, and verify that getSOA() still returns null because no SOARecord has been added.

group: Zone#getSOA after removing the only SOA record

cases.description: Create a Zone, add an SOARecord via addRecord, then remove it with removeRecord. After removal, getSOA() must return null.

group: Zone#getSOA after removing SOA via removeRRset

cases.description: Create a Zone, add an SOARecord, then call removeRRset with the SOARecord's name and Type.SOA. getSOA() should return null because the RRset containing the SOA has been removed.

group: Zone#getSOA when a second SOARecord overwrites the first

cases.description: Add an initial SOARecord to a Zone, then add a different SOARecord (same name, different serial). The second addition should replace the first; getSOA() must return the second SOARecord instance.

group: Zone#getSOA after adding SOA via RRset

cases.expected: SOARecord instance (the one contained in the RRset)
cases.description: Create an RRset that contains a single SOARecord, add the RRset to the Zone with addRRset, and verify that getSOA() returns the SOARecord from that RRset.
Populate a Zone with several records including an SOARecord, then clear all data (e.g., by creating a new empty Zone instance or by removing each RRset). After clearing, getSOA() must return null.
